iti35:1.1: (Duk. I.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti35:2.1: Nayidaṃ bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ vussati jana kuhanatthaṃ janalapanatthaṃ lābhasakkārasilokānisaṃsatthaṃ iti maṃ jano jānātū-ti. Atha kho idaṃ bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ vussati saṃvaratthañca pahānatthañcā-ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti35:3.1: Saṃvaratthaṃ pahānatthaṃ brahmacariyaṃ anītihaṃ | adesayī so bhagavā nibbānogadhagāminaṃ ||
iti35:4.1: Esa maggo mahattehi anuyāto mahesino | ye ye taṃ paṭipajjanti yathā buddhena desitaṃ | dukkhassantaṃ karissanti satthusāsanakārino ti ||
iti35:5.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||8||
